title: Capcom reports 81% profit increase thanks to Resident Evil Requiem and Pragmata
summary: Pragmata sales exceed 2.5 million copies in three months, driving the best financial results in the company's history alongside the success of Resident Evil.

title: PlayStation Plus announces free games for August 2026
summary: Subscribers will receive two cooperative adventures and an extra pack for Marvel fans, in a lineup oriented towards group play.

title: Double Fine lays off a quarter of its staff after splitting from Xbox
summary: The independent studio cuts 23 jobs weeks after Microsoft delisted it from XGS, causing shock in the industry.

title: President of Wizards of the Coast resigns after only two years in the position
summary: John Hight will leave his position on September 1st amid the unprecedented success of Magic: The Gathering, in a move that surprises the industry.

title: Rockstar blocks access to the GTA Online casino in Australia
summary: The company decides to prevent gambling with fake money in the country's virtual casinos, generating criticism and fears about possible restrictions in GTA 6.

title: Marvel launches Spider-Man: Brand New Day in cinemas and video games with cross-promotion
summary: The film receives mixed reviews while Marvel's Spider-Man 2 and Marvel Tōkon are updated with themed content, although the games suffer from performance issues on PC.

title: Silent Hill: Townfall is shaping up to be one of the scariest games of 2026
summary: No Code's team explains their first-person approach, promises five different endings, and aims for players to debate its mysteries for decades.

title: Director of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 criticizes the end of physical discs on PlayStation
summary: The development team confirms they are working on a version for Nintendo Switch 2, although they admit it is a great technical challenge for the demanding title.

title: Krafton turns Subnautica into a main franchise after the success of Subnautica 2
summary: The second installment exceeds 5 million sales in 22 days, driving the company's record revenue and confirming the potential of the franchise.

title: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers will have a sequel directed by its original creator
summary: The new studio Indolphinity, founded by the original director after the dissolution of the previous team, develops the continuation of the acclaimed soulslike.

title: BioWare loses the technical knowledge necessary to remaster the Dragon Age trilogy
summary: Former producers confirm that no current employee knows how the original engine works, although they insist that a remaster would be very valuable.

title: Xbox suffers a global outage of 15 hours that prevents users from playing
summary: A massive crash of Xbox servers affects millions of players worldwide, generating a wave of complaints on social media.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved arrives on PlayStation 5 with better performance than on Xbox
summary: Microsoft's remake for PS5 and Xbox shows superior performance on PS5 Pro according to initial technical analyses, generating debate among players.

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour announces a closed network test for September
summary: SEGA's new driving game will feature competitive multiplayer on a West Coast map, with a beta scheduled from September 11 to 13.

title: Pokémon Pokopia receives its first DLC, Bubbly Basin, next week
summary: The aquatic expansion of the game will arrive on August 5th along with update 2.0.0, and its availability on Nintendo Switch 2 is confirmed.

title: Final Fantasy 14 prepares for a crossover with FF7 and to simplify its extensive content
summary: Yoshi-P seeks to make the experience less overwhelming for new players, while the collaboration with Final Fantasy 7 generates great excitement among fans.

title: Henry Cavill's Warhammer 40,000 project at Amazon adds a horror director
summary: The film adaptation of the popular Games Workshop universe continues development with the incorporation of a renowned horror filmmaker, reigniting interest.

title: Xbox confirms its presence at Gamescom 2026 with 25 playable games
summary: Microsoft's company announces its lineup for the German fair, including first-party titles and those from its associated studios.

title: Koei Tecmo reinforces its support for Nintendo Switch 2 and will avoid relying on major franchises
summary: The Japanese company trusts in the success of Switch 2 and reveals high expectations for Wo Long 2 and Attack on Titan 3.

title: Nexus Mods seeks to simplify mod installation to attract more players
summary: The world's largest modding platform reflects on its first year under new ownership and works on making mods as easy to use as Spotify.
